description: Immutable ATS producer events and host run state vocabulary. Unknown extension fields permitted.

run_finished_v1.description: One persisted run_finished event per task_flow invocation, after all work including base update and publishing. Live phase finished is not a completion record. Preflight failures may have no assigned event. A hard process termination cannot guarantee completion storage.

required.approved: boolean; true exactly when outcome is approved
required.duration_seconds: non-negative number; monotonic wall time for the entire task_flow invocation, rounded to tenths of a second; parallel time is not summed
required.review_rounds: non-negative integer; count of successfully persisted review_result events in this invocation, including parallel parts, integration and base-update reviews; security passes combined into one review_result count once
required.outcome: approved, escalated, blocked, error or interrupted

run_finished_v1.performance: Only assigned plus run_finished events in the same project/task supply a sample. Revisions are max(0, review_rounds - 1); duration_seconds is the run total. Incomplete historical runs remain unsampled.

rules.producer: ATS CLI owns event generation, review verdict and approval gate
rules.consumer: ATS-app projects validated events into a UI read model; it does not redefine ATS approval
rules.unknown_events: preserve unknown event types for forward compatibility; ignore in projections
rules.knowledge: agent observations must carry evidence and cannot override policy
